N_ios.text:
Isang beses mo lang isusulat ang sagot, at magagamit mo na ito sa lahat ng padadalhan mo. Puwede nang magkaroon ang cutling ng blangko para sa bahaging nag-iiba, gaya ng pangalan o order number. Pag-tap mo sa cutling na iyon, itatanong ng Cutling keyboard ang pangalan at ipapakita ang mga pangalang nagamit mo na, kaya isang tap lang ang pagpili. Saka nito ita-type ang buong sagot. Puwede mo ring i-type muna ang pangalan, tapos i-tap ang cutling.

Sa mga petsa, wala ka nang kailangang gawin. Puwedeng maglaman ang cutling ng petsa ngayong araw, ng petsa bukas, ng petsa isang linggo mula ngayon, o ng oras, at tama ang lalabas sa araw na gamitin mo ito. Puwede rin itong magbigay ng pagpipilian (halimbawa, Basic o Premium na plan), isama ang huling tekstong kinopya mo, o iwan ang cursor kung saan mo gustong ituloy ang pag-type. Nasa button na “Mga variable” ang lahat ng ito habang nag-e-edit ka ng cutling. Ang mga kulot na brace na ikaw mismo ang nag-type ay mananatiling ordinaryong teksto, kaya gagana pa rin gaya ng dati ang mga cutling na mayroon ka na.

Makakapagsulat ka na ng cutling gaya ng pagsusulat mo sa Notes app ng Apple, kaya wala kang bagong pag-aaralan. Bumubukas na ang teksto ng cutling sa sarili nitong page, na may bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, highlight, monospace, mga link, at mga listahang may bullet, gitling o numero.

Mas malaki na rin ang espasyo. Kasya na ang 5,000 tekstong cutling at 500 larawan, mula sa dating 100 at 25. Aabot sa 10,000 character ang isang cutling, sapat para sa isang buong email.

Nagta-type na ang bawat key sa Cutling keyboard. Kapag nag-tap ka ng cutling na may format, ita-type ito gaya ng iba. Pindutin ito nang matagal para makopya ito kasama ang format.

Kung hindi mo natapos idagdag ang Cutling keyboard, buksan ang “Pag-setup ng keyboard” sa Cutling. Ipinapakita ng bagong gabay ang tatlong hakbang sa Settings app sa isang maikling video.
N_ios.back:
You will write the reply just one time, and you can then use it for everyone you will send it to. A cutling can now have a blank for the part that differs, like a name or an order number. When you tap that cutling, the Cutling keyboard will ask the name and show the names you have already used, so picking takes just one tap. Then it will type the whole reply. You can also type the name first, then tap the cutling.

With dates, there is nothing more you need to do. A cutling can contain today's date, tomorrow's date, the date one week from now, or the time, and what comes out is correct on the day you use it. It can also give a choice (for example, a Basic or Premium plan), include the last text you copied, or leave the cursor where you want to continue typing. All of this is at the button “Variables” while you are editing a cutling. Curly braces that you yourself typed will stay ordinary text, so the cutlings you already have will still work as before.

You can now write a cutling the way you write in Apple's Notes app, so you have nothing new to learn. The cutling's text now opens in its own page, with bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, highlight, monospace, links, and lists with bullets, dashes or numbers.

The space is also bigger now. 5,000 text cutlings and 500 images now fit, from the former 100 and 25. One cutling can reach 10,000 characters, enough for one whole email.

Every key on the Cutling keyboard now types. When you tap a cutling that has formatting, it will be typed like the others. Press it for a long time to copy it together with the formatting.

If you did not finish adding the Cutling keyboard, open “Keyboard Setup” in Cutling. The new guide shows the three steps in the Settings app in one short video.
N_ios.note: Everyday Taglish with 'mo/ka', the register of the app's own Filipino strings: English stays for what Filipino phone users call by its English name (tap, keyboard, button, bold, Settings, Notes). Apple ships no Filipino interface, so Notes and Settings keep the English names the reader sees on the phone.

N_mac.text:
Isang beses mo lang isusulat ang sagot, at magagamit mo na ito sa lahat ng padadalhan mo. Puwede nang magkaroon ang cutling ng blangko para sa bahaging nag-iiba, gaya ng pangalan o order number. Kapag pinili mo ang cutling na iyon gamit ang ⌘⇧V, may maikling form na magtatanong ng pangalan bago ito i-paste, at isang click lang ang mga pangalang nagamit mo na.

Sa mga petsa, wala ka nang kailangang gawin: ang petsa ngayong araw, ang petsa bukas, ang petsa isang linggo mula ngayon, o ang oras ay tama sa araw na gamitin mo ang cutling. Puwede ring magbigay ang cutling ng pagpipilian (halimbawa, Basic o Premium na plan) o isama ang huling tekstong kinopya mo. Nasa button na “Magdagdag ng variable” ang lahat ng ito, sa mismong ibaba ng teksto habang nag-e-edit ka ng cutling. Ang mga kulot na brace na ikaw mismo ang nag-type ay mananatiling ordinaryong teksto, kaya mape-paste pa rin gaya ng dati ang mga cutling na mayroon ka na.

Mas malaki na rin ang espasyo. Kasya na ang 5,000 tekstong cutling at 500 larawan, mula sa dating 100 at 25. Aabot sa 10,000 character ang isang cutling, sapat para sa isang buong email.
N_mac.back:
You will write the reply just one time, and you can then use it for everyone you will send it to. A cutling can now have a blank for the part that differs, like a name or an order number. When you pick that cutling using ⌘⇧V, a short form will ask the name before it is pasted, and the names you have already used are just one click.

With dates, there is nothing more you need to do: today's date, tomorrow's date, the date one week from now, or the time is correct on the day you use the cutling. A cutling can also give a choice (for example, a Basic or Premium plan) or include the last text you copied. All of this is at the button “Add Variable”, right below the text while you are editing a cutling. Curly braces that you yourself typed will stay ordinary text, so the cutlings you already have will still be pasted as before.

The space is also bigger now. 5,000 text cutlings and 500 images now fit, from the former 100 and 25. One cutling can reach 10,000 characters, enough for one whole email.
N_mac.note: Same voice as the iPhone text, with 'click' and 'i-paste' as the app's Mac strings have them.
